'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
****A deadly battle between the [[Puntland Security Force]] and [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|Islamic State]] results in the killing of 57 foreign militants in Dharin area of [[Bari Region]], [[Puntland]]. The vessel was taken captive off the coast of the [[Qaw]] district in the [[Bari Region]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/news/east-africa/puntland-forces-seize-boat-carrying-illegal-weapons-4913972 (''The East African'')]

**[[Israel]] withdraws from the [[United Nations Human Rights Council]], accusing the [[United Nations|UN]] body of "obsessively demonizing" and discriminating against the country. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/bkog7qwk1e (Ynet News)]
